candidates.text: The purpose of this document is to define the system enhancement required to introduce a permission to the internal configuration setting “RestrictChangeInCSDepIfPOCreated.” This enhancement ensures that once a PO (Purchase Order) is created, changes to CS Department (Cost Sheet Department) fields will be restricted unless the user holds a specific override permission.

The purpose of this document is to define the system enhancement required to introduce a permission to the internal configuration setting “RestrictChangeInCSDepIfPOCreated.” This enhancement ensures that once a PO (Purchase Order) is created, changes to CS Department (Cost Sheet Department) fields will be restricted unless the user holds a specific override permission.
Currently this setting is internal and there is no permission to a specific user to change in case of specific cases so permission required for the internal setting.
If permission is given to the user then user must allow to change the dependency.
